name: 简约沉浸
description: 源自 rico-md 的「简约沉浸」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 10px 8px 28px 8px; font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei UI, Microsoft YaHei, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.78; letter-spacing: 0.022em; color: {{text}}; background-color: #ffffff; word-wrap: break-word; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 42px 8px 20px 8px; font-size: 31px; line-height: 1.28; letter-spacing: 0.008em; color: {{heading}}; font-weight: 700">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 36px 8px 18px 8px; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.34; letter-spacing: 0.006em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95); font-weight: 700">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 30px 8px 14px 8px; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.004em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.93); font-weight: 650">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="margin: 24px 8px 12px 8px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.46; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92); font-weight: 600">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92); background-color: {{surface}}; border: 1px solid #e6ebf1">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}
